title: Efficiency of two impeller designs
intro: A pump maker tested 10 pumps with a new impeller and 10 with the old one. Efficiency (%): new, mean 78.6 and standard deviation 1.4; old, mean 77.0 and standard deviation 1.6. Retooling pays only if the new impeller gains more than 1.0 percentage point. The 95 % Welch interval for μ_new − μ_old.
